slots.prompt_rule: One item: `passage` = an unseen paragraph of 100–140 words about everyday school or family life (no real people, no religious text); `parts` = [{key:"questions", questions:[5, the fifth asks for a suitable title (مناسب عنوان)]}, {key:"pick", pick:{"اسم معرفہ":[4], "اسم نکرہ":[4], "اسم صفت":[4], "فعل":[4]}} — every word copied exactly as written in the paragraph, inflection included (two spares of each kind; the scheme keeps the first two that are in the paragraph), {key:"antonyms", antonyms:[[word from the paragraph, its antonym], two pairs]}].
